source: Transcribed from the Rigol Programming Guide for DM3058/DM3058E (Jan. 2015). The DM3058 also answers two compatibility languages — Fluke 45 and Agilent 34401A — which the guide documents in chapters of their own; only the native RIGOL set is carried here, because which language the meter is listening to is a front-panel setting the app cannot see.
